heading.en: How much satisfaction is in one more glass?

hook.en: On a hot day, the first glass of sugarcane juice is wonderful. Is the fourth glass just as good?
hook.kn: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನ ದಿನ ಮೊದಲ ಲೋಟ ಕಬ್ಬಿನ ಹಾಲು ಅದ್ಭುತ. ನಾಲ್ಕನೇ ಲೋಟವೂ ಅಷ್ಟೇ ರುಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆಯೇ?

objectives.en: Define utility, total utility and marginal utility
State the law of diminishing marginal utility
Find the consumer's equilibrium with one good

narration.en: On a hot day, the first glass of sugarcane juice is wonderful. Is the fourth glass just as good?

title.en: Utility, total utility and marginal utility

body.en: Utility is the want-satisfying power of a commodity. In cardinal utility analysis we assume satisfaction can be measured in units called utils. Total utility (TU) of n units is the total satisfaction from consuming them. Marginal utility (MU) is the change in total utility from one more unit: $MU_n = TU_n - TU_{n-1}$. Total utility is the sum of the marginal utilities.

points.en: MU can be positive, zero or negative

narration.en: Utility is the satisfaction a good gives. Total utility is the satisfaction from all units consumed; marginal utility is the extra satisfaction from one more unit.
narration.kn: ಸರಕು ನೀಡುವ ತೃಪ್ತಿಯೇ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ. ಸೇವಿಸಿದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಘಟಕಗಳಿಂದ ಸಿಗುವ ತೃಪ್ತಿ ಒಟ್ಟು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ; ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಘಟಕದಿಂದ ಸಿಗುವ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ತೃಪ್ತಿ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ.

title.en: TU and MU from a table

say.en: Let us build a table. Satisfaction from glasses of juice: total utility 10, 18, 24, 28, 30, 30, 28.
Marginal utility is the difference between successive totals: 10, 8, 6, 4, 2, 0 and then minus 2.
Now the graph. Total utility rises, flattens at the top, then falls. Marginal utility is a falling line.
Remember the three rules: MU positive, TU rises; MU zero, TU is maximum; MU negative, TU falls.

narration.en: Let us build a table. Satisfaction from glasses of juice: total utility 10, 18, 24, 28, 30, 30, 28.

body.en: The law of diminishing marginal utility states that as a consumer consumes more and more units of a commodity, the marginal utility from each successive unit goes on falling, other things remaining the same. It assumes the units are identical, consumed one after another without a long gap, and that tastes do not change.

narration.en: As we consume more units of a good, each additional unit gives less extra satisfaction. That is the law of diminishing marginal utility.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಸರಕಿನ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಘಟಕಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇವಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಘಟಕದಿಂದ ಸಿಗುವ ತೃಪ್ತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದೇ ಕ್ರಮಾಗತ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ ಕ್ಷೀಣ ನಿಯಮ.

body.en: A consumer buying one good compares the marginal utility of each unit (in rupees) with its price. He buys more while $MU_x > P_x$ and stops where $MU_x = P_x$. With two goods, he is in equilibrium when the last rupee spent on each good gives the same marginal utility: $MU_x/P_x = MU_y/P_y$ (law of equi-marginal utility). Diminishing MU also explains why the demand curve slopes downward: a consumer buys more only at a lower price.

points.en: Two goods: MUx/Px = MUy/Py = MU of money

narration.en: With one good, the consumer is in equilibrium where marginal utility equals price. With two goods, marginal utility per rupee must be equal for both.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಸರಕಿದ್ದಾಗ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಸಮವಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಭೋಗಿ ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಎರಡು ಸರಕುಗಳಿದ್ದಾಗ ಪ್ರತಿ ರೂಪಾಯಿಗೆ ಸಿಗುವ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಸಮವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು.

caption.en: Total utility TU = a·q − b·q² and its marginal utility MU = a − 2b·q. Move q and watch MU fall and TU reach its peak.

tryThis.en: Move q to the point where MU reads 0. What happens to TU there?
Raise b. Does saturation come sooner or later?
Push q beyond the maximum: what sign does MU take?

narration.en: Total utility TU = a·q − b·q² and its marginal utility MU = a − 2b·q. Move q and watch MU fall and TU reach its peak.

problem.en: Ravi's total utility from ice-creams is 20, 36, 48, 56, 60, 60, 56 utils for 1 to 7 units. Find MU of each unit. If an ice-cream costs ₹8 and 1 util = ₹1, how many will he buy?

steps.en: He buys while MU ≥ price: units 1 to 4 have MU 20, 16, 12, 8.
At the 4th unit MU = 8 = price; the 5th unit gives MU 4 < ₹8, so he stops.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Ravi's total utility from ice-creams is 20, 36, 48, 56, 60, 60, 56 utils for 1 to 7 units. Find MU of each unit. If an ice-cream costs ₹8 and 1 util = ₹1, how many will he buy?

body.en: MU is the slope of TU. Positive MU: TU climbs. Zero MU: TU is at the top. Negative MU: TU falls.

narration.en: Read TU from MU. MU is the slope of TU. Positive MU: TU climbs. Zero MU: TU is at the top. Negative MU: TU falls.

mnemonic.en: Plus climbs, Zero tops, Minus drops

points.en: Utility is the want-satisfying power of a good; MU is the change in TU from one more unit.
points.kn: ಸರಕಿನ ಬಯಕೆ ತಣಿಸುವ ಶಕ್ತಿಯೇ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ; ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಘಟಕದಿಂದ ಒಟ್ಟು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ.

points.en: MU diminishes as more units are consumed.
points.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಘಟಕಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇವಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: TU is maximum when MU is zero.
points.kn: ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ಒಟ್ಟು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ.

points.en: Equilibrium: MUx = Px for one good; MUx/Px = MUy/Py for two goods.
points.kn: ಸಮತೋಲನ: ಒಂದು ಸರಕಿಗೆ MUx = Px; ಎರಡು ಸರಕುಗಳಿಗೆ MUx/Px = MUy/Py.

homework.en: Draw TU and MU curves from your own table of 6 units and mark the saturation point.

narration.en: Recap. Utility is the want-satisfying power of a good; MU is the change in TU from one more unit. MU diminishes as more units are consumed. TU is maximum when MU is zero. Equilibrium: MUx = Px for one good; MUx/Px = MUy/Py for two goods.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸರಕಿನ ಬಯಕೆ ತಣಿಸುವ ಶಕ್ತಿಯೇ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ; ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಘಟಕದಿಂದ ಒಟ್ಟು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಘಟಕಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇವಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ಒಟ್ಟು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ. ಸಮತೋಲನ: ಒಂದು ಸರಕಿಗೆ MUx = Px; ಎರಡು ಸರಕುಗಳಿಗೆ MUx/Px = MUy/Py.
